subject: Board of Health Community Connectors
overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn introduced multilingual community connectors from the Board of Health, who highlighted city assistance programs, MassHealth renewals, and upcoming English classes for residents.

items.title: Board of Health Multilingual Community Connectors
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn introduced community liaisons Marilea and Samia, who explained their role in connecting residents to city services, MassHealth coverage renewals, and English as a Second Language classes.
